Nora (CS): Drafting a tiny kickstart checklist for AMs to run in the first 10 minutes of trial kickoff. Keep it copy-pasteable.
Jin (Solutions): yes please. one-liner prefill + 3 checks is perfect.
Nora (CS): Core checklist (paste into notes):
Nora (CS): - Run idempotent prefill (templates + last_20 messages)
Nora (CS): - Start warm pool: reserve 2 sessions for 12h
Nora (CS): - Enable streaming fallback and client retry (3x w/ jitter)
Omar (SRE): Ops tips: set autoscale min=2 for 12h, healthcheck GET /healthz after pool creation, and tag alerts to the assigned AM.
Rina (PM): Renewal signal: schedule a day-7 pulse. If active_users_day7 < 0.4 * avg_day1-3 OR avg_latency > 1000ms then put on a renewal watch.
Nora (CS): One-line prefill (pasteable):
Nora (CS): ```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/prefill" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"TENANT_X","idempotency_key":"onboard-$(date +%s)","items":[{"type":"template","name":"starter"},{"type":"history","last_n":20}]}'
```
Jin (Solutions): note: run at most once per 24h during initial ramp. Add customer note: "We preloaded a few examples to speed up responses; reply if you'd like us to stop."
Omar (SRE): Telemetry thresholds to add to alerting: 5xx_rate > 0.5% OR streaming_error_rate > 1% OR p99_stream_latency > 1200ms. Also track prefill failures by tenant.
Nora (CS): Small AM script to paste into kickoff: 
Nora (CS): - Prefill_done? (yes/no)
Nora (CS): - Warm_pool_active? (yes/no)
Nora (CS): - First_10_eval_prompts collected? (yes/no)
Jin (Solutions): UX tip: for live chat recommend batch_size=2; for async jobs batch_size=6-8. Call out long-context shaping (truncate earlier history).
notify-bot: Reminder scheduled: create day-7 pulse for tenant TENANT_X (automated).
Rina (PM): I'll add this to the renewal playbook as "Kickstart + day7 pulse" and link the AM checklist.
Nora (CS): I'll upload the one-pager + curl to the template library and cc the solutions folder. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
